results.ask: Who should I talk to about starting a running group?
results.expect: names a group from outersunset.us or a person from people.yml rather than writing a plan; cites
results.answer:
There are already a few movement groups out here you could check out for inspiration or to see if they'd welcome a new spin-off:

* **Sunset Dunes parkrun:** A free weekly 5k every Saturday at 8am in Sunset Dunes. The organizers are usually friendly and know how the park works. [parkrun.us/sunsetdunes](https://www.parkrun.us/sunsetdunes/)
* **Walking groups:** Neighbors who walk together regularly. Look for their flyers near Black Bird on Irving and Andytown on Lawton. [outersunset.us](https://outersunset.us)

If you want to start something new, the **Sunset Social Club** is the best place to talk to. They help neighbors organize gatherings and workshops, and they can point you to the right permits or flyers. [sunsetsocialclub.org/contact](https://sunsetsocialclub.org/contact)

You can also post a flyer on the **Sunset Board** to find other runners. [sunsetboard.org/add](https://sunsetboard.org/add)
